title: Six resolving oplax model edge squares
statement: SectionEdges Λ f μ P Q H

proof.text: Resolve each arbitrary section complex by a flat-term K-flat complex. Construct the internal flat K-flat resolution and transfer it through the fixed exact section equivalence; section_kflat_tensor_comparison identifies its resolving property. Form the two natural transformations on cochain pairs whose components are the two sides of the representative equation. They agree on resolving pairs by h. Naturality along the pair of resolution maps extends their equality to every pair, since the source functor sends this pair to an isomorphism.

Expand the six prescribed vertex maps. The source associator edge is the normalized localization associator law followed by naturality of epsilon. For the two outer splitting edges use naturality of mu in the unresolved modelTensor input and the all-pairs representative equation. For the two inner splitting edges use that representative equation at the inner pair and naturality of the target modelTensor. Tensor bifunctoriality identifies all composites with the fixed vertices. The final associator edge is naturality in the three epsilon maps followed by the target normalized localization associator law.
